'''Tony''' (Japanese: '''トニー''' ''Tony'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW138|Go, Go Gogoat!]].''

Tony went to [[Alexa's Gogoat]] after it became distant from {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, since they didn't know much about it at the time. Tony took it with him on a journey in order to see [[Tony's parents|his father]] on the other side of the island. The group found out that Gogoat was gone and Tony's mother, along with an [[Officer Jenny]], asked the group about his whereabouts. The group went off to search for both Tony and Gogoat.

When [[Alexa]] and Ash found them, Tony had Gogoat run off with him, since he was shy around them. However, Alexa comforted him and he explained about the drawing of a {{p|Braviary}} that he wanted to deliver to his father. As a group of {{p|Foongus}} attacked them, Tony, Alexa, and Ash rode on Gogoat, away from them until they encountered an unstable bridge. With the help of Gogoat and {{AP|Pikachu}}, the three crossed the substitute bridge and Tony got to see his father. In the nighttime, the family reunited with each other as they watched the {{pkmn|constellation}} of a Braviary in the night sky.
